name: application-consent-version-banner
title: Consent Version Banner
description: Updated-terms notice with a view-changes link and an accept action, for re-consenting existing users to a revised policy — distinct from application-consent-checklist, which collects initial agreement rather than re-consent to an update.
useWhen: Notifying existing users that a Terms of Service or Privacy Policy has been updated and needs re-acceptance.
Summarizing what changed in a policy update so users don't have to read the full document.
Offering a 'Remind me later' path alongside acceptance for a less disruptive re-consent flow.
avoidWhen: This is a user's first time agreeing to terms — use application-consent-checklist instead.
No real change summary is available — link to a diff or changelog rather than fabricating bullet points.
The update is legally required with no opt-out — consider whether 'Remind me later' is appropriate, or require acceptance to continue.
responsiveBehavior: The floating banner in variant 1 has a fixed max width and keeps its title and Accept button on one row down to narrow tablet widths, wrapping only at very small viewports; the card in variant 2 has a fixed max width with sufficient padding for the changelog list at any width it supports.
accessibility: The 'View changes' and 'Remind me later' controls are real buttons, not visual-only text.
The version badge in variant 2 is supplementary; the heading and effective-date text carry the primary meaning.
Each changelog item uses a real list element (ul/li) so screen readers announce it as a list, not a block of text.

variants.title: Floating banner
variants.description: Compact floating banner with a 'View changes' link and an Accept action for a quick re-consent.
accessibility: The effective date is stated in real text, not only implied by the banner's presence.

variants.title: Floating banner (Dark)
variants.description: Floating consent-update banner adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Banner text and button contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Card with changelog
variants.description: Updated-policy card with an inline changelog list and Remind me later / Accept and continue actions.
accessibility: The changelog renders as a real ul/li list so its item count and structure are announced to screen readers.

variants.title: Card with changelog (Dark)
variants.description: Updated-policy card with a changelog list, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Version badge and changelog text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
